You are given a module named "Initial_blk_mem_gen_prim_width__parameterized20" that has three ports: "douta", "clka", and "addra". The "douta" port is an output of 36 bits, "clka" is an input, and "addra" is an input of 10 bits. The module also has a wire "addra" and a wire "clka", both of which are 10 bits and 1 bit wide, respectively.

Your task is to implement the logic for the "Initial_blk_mem_gen_prim_width__parameterized20" module. The module should be able to generate a block memory of 2^10 x 36 bits. The memory should be initialized with all zeros at the beginning.

You need to implement the following:
- A synchronous read operation that reads the 36-bit data from the memory location specified by the "addra" input.
- A synchronous write operation that writes the 36-bit data to the memory location specified by the "addra" input.

You can assume that the "clka" input is a clock signal with a 50% duty cycle. The read and write operations should be performed on the rising edge of the clock signal.
